entradas.text: As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me and Lucian who kept his usual cool.
Today was a great victory for the administration.
The railway officially opened to the public as soon as we arrived and thousands began utilising it.
We moved towards the line where the first electric train was waiting.
I cut the ribbon which led to a huge wave of cheering from the crowd. Many flashes went off at the same time.
entradas.menu: Cut the ribbon.

entradas.text: “Congratulations to all. It was a solid and fruitful effort. Hopefully with much more to come.”
“It's a good moment indeed. We have helped so many in the countryside.”
“The train is prepared and ready.”
A red ribbon was hanging by the door of the train.
“Sounds fantastic. The President arriving to Lachaven on the driver seat would make the headlines for sure.”
We arrived in Holsord for the grand opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed rail. It was a proud moment for all of us.
Symon and Gus, who heavily assisted the project, were with me along with Lucian to decide on how to proceed tomorrow.
“I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. Actions speak for themselves anyway.”
“Thank you, Mr. President.”
“I see your point. But involving the President further could be beneficial for the administration.”
I entered the cab and took a seat with the assistant beside me. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me sitting as driver of the train.
entradas.menu: Enter train.

entradas.text: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do tomorrow. See you in the morning.”
“It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. There is good reason to capitalise on the occasion.”
“I'd like Gus with me.”
entradas.menu: “I'd like Gus with me.”

entradas.text: “I will drive the train on my own.”
entradas.menu: “I will drive the train on my own.”

entradas.text: Symon walked up beside me.
“I'm honored. It will be great to arrive in Lachaven with the President of Sordland.”
“I want to have Symon in the cab.”
entradas.menu: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”

entradas.text: “Who do you want to travel with in the cab, Mr. President?”
“Lucian, you would be my preference.”
entradas.menu: “Lucian, you would be my preference.”

entradas.text: “This isn't necessary but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”
“Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey. We can talk about the reforms on the way as well.”
“I agree. There is much to gain.”
entradas.menu: “I agree. There is much to gain.”

entradas.text: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”
entradas.menu: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”

entradas.text: “Sure. We will be in the other carriages. See you in Lachaven.”
“This Railway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the railway.”
entradas.menu: “This Railway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the railway.”

entradas.text: Gus came to the podium with his relaxed casual posture. He then leaned to the microphone.
As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me and Symon who smiled to the cameras.
As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me and Gus who gave a thumbs up to the cameras.
“This railway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Holsord and Lachaven is now faster and more comfortable.”
entradas.menu: “This railway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Holsord and Lachaven is now faster and more comfortable.”

entradas.text: As we began driving the train out of the central station, the media took photos of me driving by myself with the locomotive assistant next to me.
“Of course. We'll do the ceremony and open the upgraded railway to the public immediately after.”
“Very well.”
“I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”
entradas.menu: “I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”

entradas.text: I moved up to the stage to address the crowd. The press was taking dozens of pictures.
entradas.menu: Move up to the stage.

entradas.text: Lucian's voice echoed in the central station. Thousands of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the loud cheers intensified.
The new train was in pristine condition and the electric engine made much faster acceleration possible while providing minimal noise and maximum comfort.
“This railway project is a perfect example of how we can bring prosperity to the under-developed areas in between our major cities.”
“See you at the ceremony.”
entradas.menu: “See you at the ceremony.”

entradas.text: “The people will be satisfied with the improved transportation service anyway.”
“Additionally, a large crowd is invited for the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”
After the relaxing four hour drive to Lachaven, we were welcomed by celebratory citizens at Lachaven station.
Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.
“I'm sure each one of you will be proud of the achievements made during the project once we cut that ribbon. And you can get on that train yourselves.”
We were all ready to begin the ceremony. I gave the green-light and the opening address began.
entradas.menu: Signal Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entradas.text: The next day, a stage had been erected inside the central station along the new electrified railway line.
“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”
“Goodbye for now.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye for now.”

entradas.text: “Thanks, Mr. President.”
We began moving towards the stage as the excitement was growing.
“It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entradas.menu: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entradas.text: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entradas.text: The team left, leaving the rest of the evening to prepare for the big day tomorrow.
“The aim with the L-1 Railway was to improve development in rural areas and cities in between Holsord and Lachaven to create economic growth in the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions.”
entradas.menu: “The aim with the L-1 Railway was to improve development in rural areas and cities in between Holsord and Lachaven to create economic growth in the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions.”

entradas.text: “Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”
“We have to thank the mind behind the railway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “We have to thank the mind behind the railway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entradas.menu: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entradas.text: The chanting and excitement from the crowd intensified. A large group began singing the national anthem.
“Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”
entradas.menu: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”

entradas.text: “Holsordians! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “Holsordians! I welcome you today to our opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entradas.text: “None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister Gus Manger. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister Gus Manger. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “Like the good old campaign days.”
entradas.menu: “Like the good old campaign days.”

entradas.text: “We will show our best face tomorrow. Meanwhile, I'll make sure that our message of improving the countryside will get across.”
The chanting from the crowd continued. Some were yelling the motto of Holsord; High above all.
“At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entradas.menu: “At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entradas.text: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”
entradas.menu: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”

entradas.text: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”
entradas.menu: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”

entradas.text: “Things were certainly easier back then.”
“We had our disagreements, but the important thing was the outcome. Sordish people got what they needed for a long time.”
Symon stepped in for a comment.
“Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”
“I think all of us do.”
“Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entradas.menu: “Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entradas.text: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entradas.text: “Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank all who were involved in L-1.”
“On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”
Symon mentioned the beginning of a Sordish economic recovery and the plans to stop the recession altogether.
Gus continued to explain how this not only helps Holsord but also many areas along the path of the upgraded railway.
The crowd began cheering my name.
The sunny weather created a positive mood in the usually grey Holsord.
The crowd looked quite large. I spotted many party members among them.
“I welcome you Holsordians today as a proud servant of this country.”
“Our aim with this project is obvious: to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”
“Holsord! It is great to be here in this beautiful capital that does so much good for this country.”
Symon gave me a large pair of scissors to commence the opening while the crowd was watching.
“The journey to Lachaven should take about four hours and the rest of us will be in the carriage with you.”
“I have a plan on how to do that.”
“If Mr. President accepts, driving the first high-speed train to Lachaven would be great for our image nationwide.”
Lucian stood up.
“First of all...”
“Well done, everyone.”
“To many more projects like this.”
“Congratulations everyone.”
“Good work.”
entradas.menu: “Good work.”

entradas.text: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”
entradas.menu: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”

entradas.text: I silently nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: “Indeed.”
“Let's move on to our plans for the opening tomorrow.”
“What are your thoughts?”
“I think so too. Mr. President?”
“I guess we can't help it.”
entradas.menu: “I guess we can't help it.”

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “Once again, good work everyone.”
entradas.menu: “Once again, good work everyone.”

entradas.text: Lucian took Gus' place after he was done with his speech.
Lucian took Symon's place after he was done with his speech.
“Citizens of Holsord! There you have it!”
“As promised, Anton Rayne—the 4th President of Sordland—has delivered!”
“My fellow Holsordians! I welcome you today to our opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “My fellow Holsordians! I welcome you today to our opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
